  • Constructor Details

    • IMS.Product

      public IMS.Product(String productId, String productName, String category, String supplier, int unitQuantity, BigDecimal unitPrice)
      Creates a product and validates all supplied inventory fields before storing them.
      Parameters:
      productId - seven-digit product identifier
      productName - name of the inventory product
      category - product category, containing at least one letter
      supplier - supplier name, containing at least one letter
      unitQuantity - nonnegative number of units in stock
      unitPrice - nonnegative price per unit
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if any supplied field fails validation
